scenario: [LTIM.2.4.2]: a rate modifier does not exempt a rule from re-evaluation on every tick. An on-delay (`where m.dwell >= 2_s`, [LCDB.3.2.3]) on a rule with `cooldown 1_min` fires on the first pump at which it has matured, with no fact event to re-evaluate it, and its action runs once. Pin: set 0; assert Motion; pump (0 s, immature); advance 3 s, pump (matured: fires, `settled`); advance 3 s, pump (the match persists: no second firing). Messages are ['settled']. PATH PINNED: dsc.rete.now_reeval_plan re-drives the rule under a cooldown and rdsc_4a_8_2_1_fire_guard emits BINOP_AND(condition, FN_RATE_ALLOW(...)); libds rete/engine.c guard_condition reads the condition at selection and eval_actions reads guard_gate once; Mercury ds.exec.rdsc_4a_8_2_1_guard_parts splits it the same way.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    zone: String key
    ts: Time

rule settled cooldown 1_min:
    Motion m where m.dwell >= 2_s
->
    log critical "settled"
